name: Unified Design Language and Mobile PWA Cockpit
description: Replace the inherited opencode desktop personality with a single Tribunus component vocabulary (Lit Web Components) across all four surfaces: desktop, PWA phone cockpit, tablet dashboard, and GitHub Pages landing page. Established by ADR 006 and ADR 007.
objective: One component system, four shells. All surfaces share Lit-based domain components adapted via CSS Container Queries. Mobile PWA serves as remote cockpit with projection stream, command gateway, and notification gateway. Desktop remains execution authority.
